items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1969-03-24
items.q: Jeff asked him, said, Joe, you'd like to go to Japan?

ctx.x: Well, that was the time when you were playing there on weekends with what they call the All-Star Band. Do you remember?

Yeah. And George, yeah. That's right. Yeah, that was the All-Stars that played then. And, uh... Well, first thing, next thing came up was Japan. Yes. Jeff asked him, said, Joe, you'd like to go to Japan? I said, yeah, what is Spain? He told me.
